bugs.error_message: Remote hydration could overwrite newer cached quiz results; failed reads could enable destructive writes.
bugs.root_cause: Unconditional remote snapshot replacement and throttle dropped latest update.
bugs.fix: Timestamp-aware quiz reconciliation, debounce with cancellation, no remote writes after failed hydration; migration-safe fallback.

bugs.error_message: JSON null form could pass SQL validation via three-valued logic.
bugs.fix: Require numeric form; local PostgreSQL-compatible execution verifies null rejection and RLS.

bugs.error_message: Profile menu click immediately closed menu after mouseenter; general quiz retained prior completed attempt.
bugs.root_cause: Hover and click competed for dropdown state; modal mounted while closed.
bugs.fix: Native accessible account menu button; quiz modal mounted only while open.

bugs.error_message: react-hooks/set-state-in-effect in new report card and dashboard.
bugs.root_cause: Synchronous effect state updates while restoring form and scheduling fetch.
bugs.fix: Lazy form state initialization; cancellable fetch scheduling. Targeted ESLint passes.

bugs.error_message: Account switch could write previous state into next account cache; pending hydration could discard just-completed quiz.
bugs.root_cause: Queued loading state lagged effect execution; hydration merged captured cache.
bugs.fix: Hydrated account ID ref gates cache writes; functional state update merges current quiz results. Agency re-review found no remaining code release blocker.

bugs.error_message: Unversioned review could approve edited details; report delivery could race reapproval-triggering profile edit.
bugs.root_cause: Review lacked request timestamp comparison and delivery did not lock approval row.
bugs.fix: Require p_requested_at to match stored request; FOR SHARE lock serializes report delivery against FOR UPDATE registration. Verified by approval SQL suite and Agency review.

bugs.error_message: --project-ref only applies when targeting the linked project; use it with --linked
bugs.root_cause: Native db query requires --linked to select Management API even when --project-ref is supplied.
bugs.fix: Use supabase db query --linked --project-ref yzurojadggyoxyxmmwof. Production migration and role-based checks then succeeded.
